simple.summary: מַכְבָּר (makbâr) means a cloth (as netted) First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 8 15.

definitions.full: H4346. mikbar מִכְבָּר noun masculine grating or lattice-work , construct מִכְבַּר ; — Exod 27:4 and thou shalt make for it (the altar of burnt-offering in the tabernacle) נְהשֶׁת רֶשֶׁת מַעֲשֵׂה מִכְבָּר a grating , (even) a network of bronze, which surrounded the lower half of the altar ( 27:5 b): so 38:4 ; הַנְּחשֶׁת מִכְבַּר 35:16 ; 38:5 , 30 ; 39:39 .
definitions.rootNote: from 3527 in the sense of covering; (compare 4345 )
